title: Chemical SDS Binder Available On Site
instructions: Confirm SDS binder is in vehicle for OSHA compliance. Required at all job sites.

title: End-of-Day Vehicle Unload and Restock
instructions: Unload used supplies. Clean dirty tools. Restock caddy for next day.

title: Equipment Wipe-Down and Storage
instructions: Clean vacuums, mops, and reusable equipment. Store properly to extend lifespan.

title: Follow up from prior day's one-time cleans
Invoice Trigger in Jobber
instructions: Mark job complete in Jobber to trigger auto-invoice or flag for manual send.

title: Job Completion Photo, Upload to Jobber
instructions: Take before/after photos for each job. Upload directly into Jobber job record.

title: Job Notes Entry in Jobber
instructions: Log any access notes, special requests, or client feedback directly in Jobber.

title: Timesheet Entry
instructions: All employees log hours in Jobber before leaving for the day.

title: Vehicle Load-Out Check
instructions: Verify all supplies, chemicals, and equipment are loaded before departure.

title: Client Communication Follow-Up
instructions: Reply to all pending client messages, quote requests, and Jobber client actions.

title: Equipment Check and Minor Maintenance
instructions: Check vacuums, mops, and sprayers. Report any repairs needed before next week.

title: Fuel and Mileage Log Update
instructions: Log all weekly fuel receipts and mileage for company vehicles. Use for tax records.

title: Google Business Profile: Post Content
instructions: Post a Google update: before/after photo, cleaning tip, seasonal promo, or team spotlight.

title: Job Completion Quality Review
instructions: Review Jobber job notes, client feedback, and any photos submitted this week.

title: Jobber Invoice Aging Review
instructions: Pull aging report in Jobber. Flag any invoices 7+ days unpaid for follow-up.

title: New Hire / Onboarding Follow-Up
instructions: Check in with any employee in first 90 days. Address questions, confirm schedule fit.

title: New Lead Response (within 24 hours)
instructions: Respond to all new web form, phone, and referral leads within 24 hours. (The New Cleaning Request SOP sets a faster, same-day first call.)

title: Respond to Online Reviews
instructions: Respond to all new Google and Facebook reviews, positive and negative, within 7 days.

title: Social Media Post (Instagram and Facebook)
instructions: Post 1 to 2 times per week. Tip: use a before/after, a team photo, or a client testimonial.

title: Supply and Chemical Check
instructions: Visual check of cleaning caddy supplies for each crew. Flag shortages.

title: Team Huddle / Morning Briefing
instructions: Quick 10-min team briefing. Review the week's jobs, any special notes, safety reminders.

title: Timesheet Collection and Approval
instructions: Collect all employee timesheets from Jobber. Approve before EOD Friday for payroll.

title: Upcoming Schedule Confirmation
instructions: Confirm next week's jobs: assignments, keys/access, any special client instructions.

title: Vehicle Pre-Trip Inspection Log
instructions: Check tire pressure, fluid levels, and cargo for company vehicle(s) before routes.

title: Accounts Receivable Follow-Up
instructions: Follow up on any unpaid invoices 5+ days past due. Log contact attempts.

title: Bank Account Reconciliation
instructions: Reconcile business checking against Jobber revenue report and receipts.

title: Check who is due for a 3-month or 6-month review
instructions: Handbook: a raise can be considered at 3 months, then reviews every 6 months. The onboarding checklist sets reminders for both.

title: Chemical and Supply Inventory Reorder
instructions: Check stock of all cleaning products, PPE, and supplies. Place reorder if below par.

title: Credit Card Statement Review
instructions: Categorize all charges. Flag personal/mixed-use expenses before submitting to CPA.

title: Employee Time-Off Request Review
instructions: Review sick leave balances and approve/deny pending requests for next month.

title: Fall 2026 promo: check who has reached visit 5 and apply the free clean
whenText: Once a month while the promo runs
instructions: Pull the tagged clients in Jobber, count completed visits, add the discount line on visit 5, then swap the tag.

title: Federal 941 Payroll Tax Deposit
instructions: Deposit federal payroll taxes (semi-weekly or monthly based on lookback period).

title: Google Reviews: Request Campaign
instructions: Send review request via Jobber or Mailchimp to recent completed jobs.

title: Invoicing: Send All Outstanding Invoices
instructions: Review Jobber for any uninvoiced jobs. Send final invoices to all clients.

title: Jobber Schedule Audit
instructions: Confirm all upcoming jobs are scheduled, assigned, and have correct job notes.

title: Mailchimp Newsletter / Promo Send
instructions: Send monthly email to client list. Seasonal tip, promo offer, or company update.

title: Monthly P&L Review
instructions: Pull Jobber revenue report + expense summary. Compare to prior month and budget.

title: New Client Follow-Up Calls
instructions: Call or email all new clients from prior month. Request reviews and referrals.

title: Paid Leave Oregon Contributions
instructions: Deduct and remit PLO contributions each payroll cycle. paidleave.oregon.gov

title: Payroll Processing
instructions: Process payroll via payroll provider. Confirm hours in Jobber. (The Employee Handbook says pay is every two weeks; confirm which is right.)

title: Review complaints and re-cleans by team and by task
instructions: Look at every complaint and re-clean from the month. Look for repeat teams or tasks to coach. (From the Quality Control and Re-Clean SOP.)

title: Run the monthly company meeting and send out notes
instructions: New hires are added to the monthly meeting invite at onboarding. Decide where notes and action items live.

title: Safety Incident Log Review
instructions: Review any incidents or near-misses. Update OSHA 300 log if required.

title: Team Performance Check-In
instructions: Brief 1:1 or group check-in with team. Address any concerns, recognize wins.

title: Website / Lead Form Check
instructions: Test website contact form, quote request flow, and any Zapier automations.

title: Check lead numbers for the quarter
instructions: Booked rate on live calls, first-clean-to-recurring rate, and overall call-to-recurring rate. Rough targets: 50 to 60%, about 40%, and about 25 to 27%.

title: Oregon Quarterly Withholding (OQ)
whenText: Last day of the month after each quarter ends
instructions: File Oregon OQ form and remit state withholding.

title: Safety refresher with the team (chemicals, PPE, slips, emergencies)
instructions: The Nov 2025 Safety Plan promises quarterly refreshers. Confirm you still want this.

title: Training managers' meeting (technique and rules)
instructions: Trainers review technique and rules and share feedback. (From the Training Manager job description.)

title: Annual Performance Reviews
instructions: Schedule 1:1 reviews with each team member. Update compensation if applicable. (The Employee Handbook sets reviews at 3 months, then every 6 months.)

title: Arizona Secretary of State
instructions: File annual foreign entity LLC renewal.

title: BOLI Contractor License annual application
instructions: Source row has only "$350" and no month, owner or notes. Confirm whether this applies.

title: Commercial Auto Insurance Renewal
instructions: Covers company vehicles. Confirm all drivers are listed.

title: Employee Handbook Annual Review
instructions: Update for any Oregon law changes. Have attorney review if major edits.

title: Equipment Deep Inventory and Audit
instructions: Inventory all vacuums, mops, chemical supplies. Flag replacements.

title: Google Business Profile Audit
instructions: Update hours, photos, services, and request fresh reviews from top clients.

title: Oregon Secretary of State Annual Report
instructions: File annual report for LLC/Corp. Fee ~$100. sos.oregon.gov

title: Oregon State Tax Return
instructions: File Oregon Form 65 or 20-S. Confirm with CPA.

title: OregonSaves Annual Review
instructions: Confirm all eligible employees are enrolled. oregonsaves.com

title: Pricing Structure Annual Review
instructions: Adjust rates for inflation, wage increases, and competitive market analysis.

title: Update pay rates for the Oregon minimum wage change
instructions: Oregon's minimum wage changes each July 1. Check the Portland Metro rate at boli.oregon.gov and update the table in the handbook.

title: Workers Compensation Policy Renewal
instructions: Oregon requires WC for all employees. Confirm with SAIF or private carrier.

title: Year-End Financial Review with CPA
instructions: Review P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow. Plan Q1 tax strategy.
